headline: RENDERED REALMS, VERIFIED CONTROL
summary: This week moved ArkmatX toward a validated rendered world, completed BrainConnect alpha evidence on the Pi/Windows lab, consolidated BoxBrain's control and memory stack, and refreshed the live Wet Beard quest system.

projects.name: ARKMATX
projects.detail: Rendered workshop, server closet, and paradox room with separate hotspots, per-login visual variants, local journals and missions, seamless scene navigation, raster-integrity guards, and five-viewport browser QA.

projects.name: BOXBRAIN
projects.detail: Unified control plane, ten-agent workspace, ChatGPT organizer, repository-first memory stack, canonical project indexes, guarded lab recovery, and an opt-in Raspberry Pi console.

projects.name: BRAIN CONNECT
projects.detail: Authenticated controller and certificate helper deployed on Raspberry Pi 4; pinned RDP identity, bounded keyboard/pointer/scroll evidence, cleanup, and checkpoint recovery verified. Windows rescue enrollment remains disabled pending operator decisions.

projects.name: WEBSITE CLUSTER
projects.detail: Family website sources and deployment logic were consolidated into ClusterSites, with an infrastructure control plane, corrected WitchDicks identity, and restored Ubercorp visual layers and Easter eggs.

projects.name: WET BEARD
projects.detail: Quest-card and rider systems remain live; the August refresh added new bicycle quests and themed 5/10/20-star cards while preserving the existing review workflow.

projects.name: MORRI
projects.detail: The connected realm build was promoted to production with its exploration, puzzle, and shared-realm hooks preserved.

projects.name: WITCHDIX
projects.detail: The complete site remains available from the verified Bluehost fallback path while standalone-domain creation stays blocked by hosting configuration.

projects.name: XANDER ZOMBIE
projects.detail: The verified connected build was promoted with runtime data preservation; comic-engine and canon workflows remain the active development direction.

weekly_log: Rebuilt ArkmatX around rendered scenes and independent hotspot layers, then added per-login variants, expedition memory, a discovery ledger, and a mission compass.
Added real-browser coverage across desktop, tablet, portrait phone, and landscape phone, plus keyboard/touch interaction checks and raster corruption detection.
Made ArkmatX room travel seamless across physical hotspots, the journal, the signal compass, deep links, and browser Back without resetting runtime state.
Created a persistent GPT workflow-memory library and recorded reusable staging, deployment, render, binary-asset, and login-isolation fixes.
Completed BrainConnect alpha verification with the Pi controller, pinned RDP identity, bounded input and scrolling evidence, cleanup, and exact VM checkpoint restoration.
Merged a fail-closed Windows rescue foundation, pinned WinRM transport, guarded provisioning, and readiness checks while leaving live enrollment disabled.
Consolidated BoxBrain and the family website cluster, then refreshed Wet Beard with new August bicycle quests and themed reward cards.
easter_egg_seed: The room remembers the visitor; the visitor remembers a different room.
